posts.title: Version 1.2.0 is here!
items: NEW: Trades now show in chat, so everyone in the realm can see what was swapped.
NEW: Take out your Wrench to see everything nearby you can wrench.
NEW: The items you wear now move on player info pages, just like in the menu.
IMPROVED: Fishing and farming skills have new names: Enlightenment, Midas Touch, Seed Oracle, Time Keeper, Earth's Bloom and Storage Bag.
IMPROVED: Fishing on mobile: a smaller hook button, and Punch and Jump hide while you fish.
IMPROVED: The chat is wider, so long messages fit better.
IMPROVED: Hearts now only show on your Favorite realms, so you can unfavorite them there.
CHANGED: Weather Machines aren't wrenched anymore. Punch them to switch them on or off.
FIXED: Text on the Quest Keeper's page no longer glitches.
